description: An idempotency key that is not yet on the register yields NEW_INBOUND with allow_mutations true.
why_it_exists: QA - Replay Write Test (2026-08-20, one day earlier) had just shown that appendOrUpdate cannot be a no-op: update-on-match is exactly what it does, so it happily overwrote the stored content of a legal communication. The gate was written the same day: the register is read BEFORE any mutation and the mutation branch is gated on a decision, rather than trusting the Sheets node to be idempotent.
assertions: The seed row's idempotency_key (MAT-QA-001|MSG-SEED-0) differs from the key under test, so the seed can never be the row the gate matches.
A register with no matching key produces allow_mutations true, and only then do the Communications, Actions and Matters writes run.
event_id is derived from provider_message_id alone, so it is stable across runs.
Rows whose json has no keys other than row_number are not counted as register rows.
target_unresolved_reason: QA-only Decide node from c6YPmuWf3cevjZ3r. It is the idempotency-key-shaped ANCESTOR of Build Reply Context and compares downstream products (summary, classification), which the deployed resolver deliberately does not. Binding it to build-reply-context.js would assert the superseded rule against the corrected code.
